title: PVP16x_TwoDS
description: A large number of textures in the original version have been modified to adapt to PVP mini-games in Minecraft. Including commonly used blocks with outlines for PVP, PVP daggers, transparent UI and more.
body:
Massively overhauled the vanilla textures to better suit Minecraft PVP minigames. Features include PVP block outlines, PVP short swords, transparent UI, and more.
Key changes:
Modified almost all of the vanilla UI.
Added outlines to vanilla wool blocks.
Replaced the textures of all vanilla swords with PVP combat daggers/short knives.
Changed the health bar texture to the Hardcore mode style.
Added colored outlines to all vanilla armor sets.
Added colored outlines to all vanilla ore blocks.
Added red outlines to certain vanilla blocks that require extra attention.
That's all for now. More textures will be modified in the future to further optimize the PVP minigame experience...
